categories.main_business_segments: Dalian Haosen Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent production lines and intelligent equipment integration, focusing on turnkey projects including planning, R&D, design, assembly, debugging, sales, and services. Its main product lines cover automotive powertrain intelligent assembly lines for both new energy vehicles (NEVs) and traditional fuel vehicles, including lithium battery production lines, drive motor production lines, hybrid powertrain assembly lines, hydrogen fuel cell production lines, engine assembly lines, and transmission assembly lines. The company also develops embodied intelligent devices such as humanoid robots and autonomous mobile robots, and provides intelligent manufacturing software products and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 20 years of experience in automotive intelligent equipment manufacturing, with core technologies in automation, informatization, intelligence, flexibility, and green manufacturing. It has proprietary technologies in robot application, flexible assembly units, multi-model robot flexible tightening, lithium battery module stacking, hydrogen fuel cell stack automatic stacking, drive motor automatic wiring, laser welding and cleaning, digital simulation, MES systems, and machine vision. Production methods emphasize non-standard customized intelligent production lines with integrated software and hardware solutions, supported by advanced R&D in AI, virtual debugging, and embodied intelligence.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are major automotive OEMs and core component suppliers in both traditional and new energy vehicle sectors. Notable clients include Mercedes-Benz, BMW, General Motors, Volvo, BYD, SAIC-GM, FAW-Volkswagen, Changan, Cummins, and battery manufacturers like CATL and EVE Energy. The company serves global markets with a strong presence in Europe, North America, and Asia, focusing on automotive powertrain manufacturing and intelligent production equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: Haosen Intelligent operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Dalian and subsidiaries in Changzhou, Suzhou, Shenzhen, and other Chinese cities. It has established overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Hungary, and India to support sales, production, and after-sales services, enabling global market penetration and local delivery capabilities, especially in Europe, North America, and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive manufacturing supply chain, providing intelligent production lines and equipment for assembling automotive powertrain components. It integrates upstream technologies and downstream customer requirements to deliver turnkey manufacturing solutions, including software and hardware, for automotive OEMs and suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Haosen Intelligent emphasizes technology-driven growth with significant R&D investment focused on advanced manufacturing technologies, AI integration, embodied intelligence (humanoid and autonomous mobile robots), and next-generation automotive powertrain equipment such as solid-state batteries and axial motors. The company pursues global expansion, continuous product innovation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing to maintain industry leadership and meet evolving customer demands.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of customized intelligent production lines and equipment, software products, and related services. Revenue recognition occurs upon project completion and customer acceptance, typically at the end of turnkey project delivery. The company also earns income from spare parts sales and software development contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haosen Intelligent is a leading domestic player in automotive powertrain intelligent manufacturing, competing with international companies such as Comau, KUKA, ThyssenKrupp, and Gläubig, as well as domestic firms like Tianyong Intelligent and Xianhui Technology. It holds a strong position in lithium battery module PACK production lines and drive motor intelligent production lines, with recognized technology and delivery capabilities that enable it to compete globally and achieve import substitution in high-end equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.81 billion, a 9.85% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 87.9 million. Total assets increased by 15.95% to RMB 6.49 billion. The company invests heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 7.82% of revenue. Despite recent profitability challenges due to market and operational factors, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues to expand its global footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haosen Intelligent offers comprehensive, high-quality turnkey intelligent manufacturing solutions tailored to the automotive powertrain sector, emphasizing high precision, efficiency, flexibility, and stability. Its competitive advantages include deep industry expertise, proprietary core technologies, strong global customer relationships, and integrated software-hardware solutions. The company’s early adoption and development of embodied intelligence and AI-driven manufacturing position it to lead industrial paradigm shifts and meet stringent international standards.
